cards.body: Japan chapter closed with a perfect Tokyo day. Bora Bora opened a new one. Between jet skiing and Daily Context Object work, you found sustainable pace: tennis, a run, weights, Gremly progress, sobriety — all one day. The anxiety from two weeks ago ('not moving quick enough') dissolved into something quieter.
cards.quote: I feel like the daily context I have built could be really powerful.
cards.headline: Japan closed, Bora Bora blooming — rhythm found

moments.body: Golden Gai is Tokyo's most atmospheric pocket: narrow alleys of tiny bars seating eight, where strangers become extraordinary. Late February is ume (plum blossom) season — quieter, intimate precursor to sakura.
moments.title: Perfect Day Recounted in Shinjuku

moments.body: Bora Bora's lagoon — warm water, ambient sounds, no commute — is genuinely restorative. The doubled emphasis ('very very refreshed') marks a day where everything compounded.
moments.title: Everything Clicked in Bora Bora

spotlight.title: Your best Gremly days happen inside vacation
spotlight.takeaway: Vacation sharpens Gremly work. Removed from 'moving quick enough' pressure, you complete features faster with clarity about what matters.
spotlight.evidence_trail: Feb 27: 'not moving quick enough with the app.' March 8–13 (Bora Bora): Daily Context Object Integration, Fed Metaphor Exploration, Dco User Onboarding, Dco Implementation all completed. Four feature tasks in six days on honeymoon — more DCO progress than pre-departure sprint week. Pattern repeated Feb 16 (Tulum): critical fixes completed mid-travel.

cards.intro: Next week: island flight Sunday, work resumes Monday March 16, half marathon March 22 collides with return flight. Bug backlog and Merkury costs await. Monthly retro: March opened with launch and flight intertwined. Vacation vs. productivity trade-off never materialized — shipped features from lagoon, ran in heat, wrote best journal entries in months. Pre-honeymoon anxiety ('not moving quick enough') shifted to March 14 tone: 'more chill and able to work on Gremly whilst present.'
